description: Source file implementing tensor property functions for PyTorch, including size, stride, and nested tensor checks.

methods.name: is_same_size
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have the same size and shape.

methods.name: nested_is_same_size
methods.description: Checks if two nested tensors have the same nested size.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns the stride of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: sym_size
methods.description: Returns the symbolic size of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: sym_is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is symbolically contiguous with a given memory format.

methods.name: sym_stride
methods.description: Returns the symbolic stride of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: sym_numel
methods.description: Returns the symbolic number of elements in a tensor.

methods.name: sym_storage_offset
methods.description: Returns the symbolic storage offset of a tensor.

methods.name: cudnn_is_acceptable
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is acceptable for cuDNN operations.

methods.name: detach_
methods.description: In-place operation to detach a tensor.

methods.name: contiguous
methods.description: Returns a contiguous copy of the tensor with specified memory format.

methods.name: is_set_to
methods.description: Checks if one tensor is set to another (shares storage, offset, size, and stride).
